description: Ternary branches swapped in expiresIn return: item.expiry-truthy path returns Infinity instead of the real remaining time. Gap: all fp-08 tests call expiresIn on a key whose item.expiry is truthy (maxAge given), then check remaining > 5000; swapped branches return Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY which still satisfies > 5000, so the assertion passes even though the wrong value is returned.
productionImpact: Every call to expiresIn for a key that was inserted with a maxAge returns Infinity instead of the actual milliseconds remaining, causing all TTL-driven refresh logic to conclude the entry never expires. Tokens and cached data are served indefinitely past their intended TTL until the entry is evicted by size pressure alone.
